acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

claimMusharakahProfit(uint256).details: Requires `purificationEscrow` to be set (setPurificationEscrow).         The escrow contract enforces the full invariant:           purified + charity + vaultShare + depositorShare == grossProfit         v1 ZakatModule path has been removed. Existing v1 vaults retain their         ZakatModule and continue to function — only new profit claims use this path.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deployCapital(address,uint256,bytes).details: Screening check gates ALL deployments — base `deployCapital` is now virtual      so this override is the single entry point for ShariahVault capital deployment.

deployCrossChain(uint32,bytes32,uint256).details: GOLD_SPREAD requires atomic (same-transaction) settlement (yad bi yad).         Any attempt to route the goldExchangeAdapter cross-chain reverts here.         ETH_SPREAD is NOT yet gated here — see SR-007 for the pending ruling.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

params.adapter: Address implementing IStrategyAdapter (must have vault == address(this))
params.amount: Requested USDC amount to recall (adapter may return less due to slippage)

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setGoldAllocationAdapter(address).details: Only used for cap calculation — does not screen the adapter.         Call setScreened(adapter, true) separately.

setGoldSpreadAdapter(address).details: Only used for cap calculation — does not screen the adapter.         Call setScreened(adapter, true) separately.

setPurificationEscrow(address).details: Must be set before claimMusharakahProfit() can be called.         The escrow must be constructed with this vault's address, asset,         a CharityModule, and the shariahTreasury.

settleCrossChain(uint64).details: The matching CCTP burn nonce tracks the original outbound position.         Decrements `totalDeployed` so ERC-4626 NAV remains accurate.         The corresponding USDC tokens must already be in this vault (minted here         by the destination's reverse CCTP burn + source attestation) before calling.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

MAX_GOLD_BPS().notice: Hard cap: combined S2-H (PAXG) + S6-H (XAUT) value must not exceed 30% of totalAssets.

claimMusharakahProfit(uint256).notice: Distribute Shariah profit through the v2 waterfall (purification → sadaqah → Musharakah).

deployCapital(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Override deployCapital to enforce Shariah screening and accrue Wakala fee.

deployCrossChain(uint32,bytes32,uint256).notice: Override deployCrossChain to block gold-strategy cross-chain routing.

goldAllocationAdapter().notice: S6-H gold allocation adapter (GoldAllocationAdapter — XAUT). Used for combined cap check.

goldCrossChainBlocked().notice: When true, all deployCrossChain calls revert NonAtomicGoldExchange.

goldSpreadAdapter().notice: S2-H gold spread adapter (GoldExchangeAdapter — PAXG). Used for combined cap check.

purificationEscrow().notice: v2 profit-distribution waterfall: purification → sadaqah → Musharakah split.         Set via setPurificationEscrow(). If zero, claimMusharakahProfit reverts.

recallCapital(address,uint256).notice: Recall capital from an IStrategyAdapter. The adapter unwinds its position,         transfers USDC back to this vault, and returns the actual amount received.         totalDeployed is decremented by the actual return (not the requested amount)         so NAV accounting stays accurate even when slippage or fees reduce proceeds.

setGoldAllocationAdapter(address).notice: Set the S6-H gold allocation adapter address for combined cap tracking.

setGoldSpreadAdapter(address).notice: Set the S2-H gold spread adapter address for combined cap tracking.

setPurificationEscrow(address).notice: Set the PurificationEscrow address for v2 Musharakah profit distribution.

settleCrossChain(uint64).notice: Called by the manager/owner once the crosschain USDC has been bridged BACK         to this vault on the source chain (attested by the CCTP attestation service         and received via a MessageTransmitter.receiveMessage call).

sweepFeesToTreasury(address,uint256).notice: Sweep accrued fees to a receiver. Amount is capped to `pendingFees` to         prevent owner from sweeping depositor principal under the guise of fee claims.
